overview: OurHome (บ้านที่ทุกคนใฝ่ฝัน) is a premium Thai real-estate social commerce platform where customers can search projects, browse house types, view post and project details, contact agents, book site visits, save favorites, and rate agents — managed by NIC GROUP 95 (THAILAND).
features: Search and filter real-estate projects by location, price, and house type
Browse house types and view detailed project and post pages
View agent profiles with transparent ratings and gold verified badges
Book site visits and save favorites
Agent and admin dashboards with metrics and management lists
